description: Copy-trade cohort built from graduated-token early-buyer wallets, walk-forward validated (Mar/Apr/May 2026) + placebo. TWO independent strategy heads with DIFFERENT exits: 'consistent_scalp' (high win-rate, mirror the source wallet's exit) and 'moonshot' (fat-tail, our own trailing exit). Run either or both. Wallets are a SNAPSHOT (selected on 2026-06-01..06-14) and DECAY — regenerate every ~14 days (see provenance). offline != live: observe-soak before any capital.
_schema_notes: NEW format for copy-trade (no prior format existed). The engine reads `global` for trigger/size/mode, then runs each enabled entry in `strategies[]`. Each strategy = its own wallet list + its own deterministic exit. JSON has no comments; fields prefixed `_` are human notes the engine may ignore.

global._mode: 'observe' (paper) | 'live'. DEFAULT observe. Do not set live until the operator flips it post-soak.
global._usd_size_per_trade: USD per copy-buy (validated at $25; small keeps the edge). UI may override.

trigger._copy_first_buy_only: only the wallet's FIRST buy of a given token (the entry), never their adds
trigger._min_trigger_buy_usd: skip the signal unless the wallet's buy is >= this USD (the conviction filter the formula was validated on)
trigger._pump_fun_only: only pump.fun tokens (the validated universe). NOTE: the formula did NOT restrict to pre-graduation buys; copy the wallet's first >= $250 buy whenever it happens. Restricting to on-curve buys is an UNTESTED variant.
trigger._dedupe_token_across_wallets: if 2+ watched wallets buy the same token, open ONE position; attribute to the first trigger; if the two wallets are in different heads, the FIRST trigger's head owns the exit

global._reselect_cadence_days: wallets show ZERO cross-fold persistence (see provenance.findings); a stale list is worthless. Re-run the formula every ~14 days and upload a new cohort_id.

strategies.description: High win-rate, low variance. Copy the wallet's >= $250 first-buy, then EXIT WHEN THE WALLET EXITS (mirror their sell). Validated: median 1.27-1.35x, win 88-92%, +33-46% mean/trade across 3 folds, beats random pool z=2.0-3.8.

exit._type: exit OUR copy as the source wallet sells (proportional to how much they sell); this head's edge IS the wallet's exit timing, so do NOT impose our own TP/SL
exit._max_hold_seconds: fallback only: if the wallet has not fully exited by this, market-sell the remainder
exit._hard_stop_loss_pct: intentionally none; imposing a stop here was tested and LOSES vs mirroring (see provenance.findings)

strategies.description: Fat-tail. Copy the wallet's >= $250 first-buy, then RIDE with OUR OWN exit (we do NOT mirror their quick scalp). You lose most trades (win ~17-37%, median ~0.5x) but ~10% reach >= 4x. Validated +39-51% mean/trade across 3 folds, beats random pool z=5.9-11.0 (conservative floor: pessimistic non-graduate = -50%, capture capped at 10x).

exit._stop_loss_pct: hard stop: sell if down >= 50% vs our entry
exit._trailing_giveback_pct: once in profit, sell if price retraces >= 40% from the high-water mark (captures ~60% of the run; this is the modeled trailing capture)
exit._take_profit_pct: hard cap: sell at +900% (10x) regardless (the 10x cap used in validation)
exit._max_hold_seconds: no hard time cap; the trailing stop ends the ride. Operator may add one.

provenance.selection_window: 2026-06-01..2026-06-14 (most recent complete fortnight; small pool due to Jun 13-14 tape coverage drop -> few wallets passed the gate)
provenance.data_source: Birdeye /trader/txs/seek_by_time (per-wallet realized swaps, full population incl. non-graduates) + raw30k tapes for peak prices; realized buy->sell PnL, NOT candles
provenance.validation_folds: Mar 3-16->17-30, Apr 1-14->15-28, May 1-14->15-28 (walk-forward, select-half then measure unseen test-half) + random-pool placebo

hard_gates.pool: wallet was an EARLY (first-10) + BIG (>= $250) buyer on >= 2 graduates in the lookback fortnight
hard_gates.consistent_scalp: >= 20 signal trades AND median copy-multiple >= 1.25x (on the wallet's >= $250 first-buys, own-exit) in the lookback fortnight
hard_gates.moonshot: >= 4 graduated picks AND in-sample capped-ride mean >= 1.6x (ride = min(1+0.6*(peak-1),10), non-grad=0.5) in the lookback fortnight

findings_that_shaped_this: copying EVERYTHING a wallet does ~= 1.0x (noise); must filter to >= $250 first-buys
wallets have ZERO cross-fold persistence -> re-select every fortnight
for scalp wallets imposing our own TP/SL LOSES (they have low precision; their fast exit is the edge) -> mirror their sells
moonshot-catching IS selectable & persistent (peak-rate Spearman in->out +0.49..+0.86), but magnitude is lottery -> select on capped-ride
validation is OFFLINE + out-of-sample; every offline edge in this project has historically inverted live
provenance.what_is_unproven: live latency/fillability (can the engine detect the curve buy and fill fast enough; can the moonshot trailing exit actually fill into an illiquid peak); the moonshot non-graduate outcome is modeled at -50% (real OHLCV not yet pulled). The observe soak is the arbiter.
